title: Scrapyard Appraisal
summary: River takes you to a wreck field south of the city for a quiz on five cars, and the loser buys the coffee.

start.bringUp: River wants to take V to a scrapyard south of the city for a quiz about five wrecks. He says the loser buys the coffee.

variations.know: The scrapyard is dark, and you work the wrecks with a flashlight that flickers over the rust.
variations.wants: Answers that hold up in the dark.

variations.know: A rainstorm has turned the yard to mud, and the wrecks drip as you walk between them.
V asks River the quiz questions this time, and River gets to pick the wreck.

wreck-1.name: the rusted sedan in the scrapyard south of the city

wreck-2.name: the station wagon with no doors

wreck-3.name: the bus shell on its side

wreck-4.name: the old patrol car with a sealed trunk

wreck-5.name: the motorbike frame under a tarp

RWH3.inv.text: Scrapyard south of the city. Five wrecks, one quiz. Loser buys the coffee.

g1.asks: Which one of these cars would you want to be buried in?
g1.know: You have walked past four wrecks with River, and you know the quiz answers you have given so far.
g1.secret: He has a story about his own car.

stages.label: River quizzes V on five wrecks
stages.know: You are in the scrapyard south of the city with River. He is quizzing you on the make, year and history of five wrecks.
stages.wants: V to answer the quiz for each wreck and find out who buys the coffee.

appraised.memory: You got through River's quiz at the scrapyard south of the city, and he owes you the coffee.

stood-up.memory: You never came to the scrapyard south of the city, and River appraised the wrecks alone.
